assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: FAR, height, setback and road-redline conclusions remain unknown; only conceptual massing is provided.

assumptions.statement: Official precise boundaries for the three scope levels and three key areas are password-protected; provisional rough polygons are used.
assumptions.impact: All area-bearing layers and metrics are interim design-model values; recalculate when official polygons are published.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Replace site_boundary.geojson and key_areas.geojson with official geometry, re-run geometry/metrics/figures/drawings pipeline and self-check.

assumptions.statement: Existing building inventory (footprints, heights, uses, ages) is not publicly available.
assumptions.impact: Building layer expresses conceptual massing only; retain/renovate/demolish stays at strategy level.

assumptions.statement: Official road redlines and cross-sections are not available.
assumptions.impact: Roads.geojson contains conceptual centerlines only; no engineering alignments or redlines are claimed.

assumptions.statement: Heritage protection control areas (Jing-Zhang Railway Heritage Park, Qinghuayuan station site) require authority documents.
assumptions.impact: Cultural and landmark proposals stay conservative and require professional review before any engineering.

assumptions.statement: AI scenarios, test/validation pilots, events, and operation mechanisms are conceptual suggestions.
assumptions.impact: No scenario is presented as approved operation; privacy, safety, and human-review boundaries are stated per scenario.

assumptions.statement: Green ratio, public-space ratio, and building density are recomputed from submitted provisional geometry in EPSG:4548.
assumptions.impact: Values are low-confidence design-model values; official controls govern final indicators.
